prompt: A hamlet that looks like it grew over centuries, crooked lanes and all.

card.name: Centuries Hamlet

site.text: A hamlet that grew organically over centuries, with crooked lanes and irregular lots on existing land

style.text: Aged, layered medieval look: mismatched additions, weathered timber, stone and plaster, patched roofs, moss and worn paths

purpose.text: A lived-in hamlet for a small farming and crafting community

card.interpretation: You want a small hamlet that looks like it grew bit by bit over centuries. I took the site as a village-style layout on natural land, with winding lanes and uneven lots. The style is an aged medieval look with mismatched materials and later additions. Its purpose is a lived-in home community, medium density, with about 10 buildings around a central hall and green.
assumptions: Size M, about 10 buildings, inside the 64-block claim
Purpose read as a lived-in home community with some farming

program.notes: Oldest building, stone base with timber additions of later ages, stands where the lanes meet
Each different in age and shape, leaning, with patched roofs and added lean-tos
Rambling, extended over generations, with a small garden
Stone, small, with a mismatched later tower or porch
Soot-stained, open forge on a lane corner
Small irregular green with a well where lanes bend
